title: Building Touch Grass AI: Open-Source Offline Outdoor Companion & Foliage Route Builder

content.text: Touch Grass: Build something with open-source AI at its core that gets people off the screen and into the world. Ideas: bird call identifier, garden planner, run club route builder. Deploy on Render and embed DevRelay session.

I designed and built Touch Grass AI—an open-weight, offline-first outdoor web app featuring local ONNX flora & bird species identification, an interactive OpenStreetMap autumn foliage run loop builder, a weekly frost-date garden planner, and a 15-minute screen-free challenge generator.
